chunks: And it has been narrated in another report:
"Indeed, injustice in a will is among the major sins."

key_terms.الْوَصِيَّةِ: the will or bequest made concerning one's estate

ai.seo_question: Is injustice in making a will considered one of the major sins in Islam?
ai.summary: This report states that committing injustice in a will is counted among the major sins. It emphasizes the grave moral and legal responsibility to act fairly when making bequests and not violate the rights of others.
